caption: The drawing shows a detailed illustration of a sleeveless vest as the central object, accompanied by a simple line sketch of the vest’s back view on the upper right. The main vest is depicted in pale cream or light beige color and features a high collar and front button closure with closely spaced round buttons. The surface of the vest is decorated with a subtle repeating pattern of small red or pink floral motifs. The vest has two horizontal slit pockets near the waist, each with an embroidered flap that matches the ornate design along the front button placket, collar edges, and bottom hem. The decorative trim includes small floral or scrollwork designs in pastel tones. The line sketch to the upper right shows the back of the vest in simple outline, indicating the shape and placement of the seams, collar, and three ties going down the center back. The background of the image is a plain, lightly yellowed paper.
title: Waistcoat
